credible_set.study_trait: Cognitive function (executive function) x major depressive disorder interaction (2df)

interpretation: The only human genetic evidence linking FOXO1 to MDD in Open Targets derives from a gene x MDD interaction GWAS on executive function (not a primary MDD case/control GWAS). L2G=0.469 (below common 0.5 confidence cut-off). This is a QUALIFIED, indirect human signal: a FOXO1-region variant modifies the executive-function x MDD relationship, which is weaker than 'FOXO1 is an MDD risk gene'.
